WITH
  3600.0 AS max_position,
  (
    SELECT avg(mark_price)
    FROM hft.positions
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
      AND mark_price > 0
  ) AS avg_live_price
SELECT
  time,
  series,
  value
FROM
(
  SELECT
    time,
    'Live PnL %' AS series,
    sum(income) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
      / nullIf(max_position * avg_live_price, 0) * 100 AS value
  FROM
  (
    SELECT
      toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
      sum(income) AS income
    FROM hft.income
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    GROUP BY time
  )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
    'Backtest PnL %' AS series,
    avg(pnl / nullIf(max_position * mid_price, 0) * 100) AS value
  FROM hft.backtest_equity
  WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
    AND symbol = '$symbol'
    AND backtest_id = '$backtest_id'
    AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time ASC, series

WITH

SELECT

FROM
(
  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
    'Live Position %' AS series,

  FROM hft.positions
  WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
    AND symbol = '$symbol'
    AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY time

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
    'Backtest Position %' AS series,
    avg(position) / nullIf(max_position, 0) * 100 AS value
  FROM hft.backtest_equity
  WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
    AND symbol = '$symbol'
    AND backtest_id = '$backtest_id'
    AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time ASC, series

WITH
  3600.0 AS max_position,
  (
    SELECT avg(mark_price)
    FROM hft.positions
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
      AND mark_price > 0
  ) AS avg_live_price,
  live_pnl AS
  (
    SELECT
      time,
      sum(income) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        / nullIf(max_position * avg_live_price, 0) * 100 AS live_pnl_pct
    FROM
    (
      SELECT
        toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
        sum(income) AS income
      FROM hft.income
      WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
        AND symbol = '$symbol'
        AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
      GROUP BY time
    )
  ),
  backtest_pnl AS
  (
    SELECT
      toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
      avg(pnl / nullIf(max_position * mid_price, 0) * 100) AS backtest_pnl_pct
    FROM hft.backtest_equity
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND backtest_id = '$backtest_id'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    GROUP BY time
  )
SELECT
  coalesce(live_pnl.time, backtest_pnl.time) AS time,
  'PnL Deviation %' AS series,
  ifNull(live_pnl.live_pnl_pct, 0) - ifNull(backtest_pnl.backtest_pnl_pct, 0) AS value
FROM live_pnl
FULL OUTER JOIN backtest_pnl ON live_pnl.time = backtest_pnl.time
ORDER BY time ASC

WITH
  3600.0 AS max_position,
  (
    SELECT avg(mark_price)
    FROM hft.positions
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
      AND mark_price > 0
  ) AS avg_live_price,
  live_pnl AS
  (
    SELECT
      time,
      sum(income) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
        / nullIf(max_position * avg_live_price, 0) * 100 AS live_pnl_pct
    FROM
    (
      SELECT
        toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
        sum(income) AS income
      FROM hft.income
      WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
        AND symbol = '$symbol'
        AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
      GROUP BY time
    )
  ),
  backtest_pnl AS
  (
    SELECT
      toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time,
      avg(pnl / nullIf(max_position * mid_price, 0) * 100) AS backtest_pnl_pct
    FROM hft.backtest_equity
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND backtest_id = '$backtest_id'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    GROUP BY time
  ),
  aligned AS
  (
    SELECT
      coalesce(live_pnl.time, backtest_pnl.time) AS time,
      ifNull(live_pnl.live_pnl_pct, 0) AS live_pnl_pct,
      ifNull(backtest_pnl.backtest_pnl_pct, 0) AS backtest_pnl_pct
    FROM live_pnl
    FULL OUTER JOIN backtest_pnl ON live_pnl.time = backtest_pnl.time
  )
SELECT
  '$strategy_id' AS strategy_id,
  '$symbol' AS symbol,
  '$backtest_id' AS backtest_id,
  corrStable(live_pnl_pct, backtest_pnl_pct) AS pnl_correlation,
  max(abs(live_pnl_pct - backtest_pnl_pct)) AS max_deviation_pct,
  argMax(live_pnl_pct, time) AS live_final_pnl_pct,
  argMax(backtest_pnl_pct, time) AS backtest_final_pnl_pct,
  (
    SELECT count()
    FROM hft.income
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND income_type = 'REALIZED_PNL'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
  ) AS live_trade_count,
  (
    SELECT toInt64(max(num_trades))
    FROM hft.backtest_equity
    WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy_id'
      AND symbol = '$symbol'
      AND backtest_id = '$backtest_id'
      AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime
  ) AS backtest_trade_count
FROM aligned
